item.description: The Rainbow Christian Fellowship Group began in 2026 with the first gathering on February 17.Being Shrove Tuesday, also known as Pancake Tuesday, it was decided to have some fun and bake up a storm with pancakes for all to enjoy.Lauris Bretag and Ann Dent whipped up the pancakes, which were lavished with a range of toppings from crab meat to strawberries and ice cream; enjoyed by all, with no one going home hungry! item.title: Dance fun returns to Hopetoun
item.description: Town’s qualified dance teacher, Karleigh Martin has brought 'Dance 4 Fun' back to Hopetoun, and local children got the program off to a lively start this week at the Hopetoun Memorial Hall.The program runs on Monday afternoons with three classes for different age groups, giving children a fun and active way to learn new dance moves and enjoy time with their friends.A total of 27 children took part across the three classes in the first session, where they practised their routines, built confidenc

item.title: Council celebrates inclusion day
item.description: Hindmarsh Shire Council marked International Day of People with a Disability with a community celebration at the Dimboola Bowling Club on February 11.About 60 people attended the event, which gave residents a welcoming and inclusive space to connect, enjoy activities and spend time together.Guests enjoyed music, a barbecue, games and lawn bowls during the day.Although temperatures were high, attendees stayed comfortable and shared lunch inside the club's fully air-conditioned rooms.Hindmarsh Shi

item.title: Horsham City midweek pennant champs
item.description: Horsham City have claimed the Wimmera Playing Area division one midweek pennant title, narrowly defeating Nhill in the grand final at Dimboola on Tuesday February 24.In division two, Horsham Golf proved too strong for Serviceton. In rink one of division one, Horsham City's team of Kevin Gepp, Hux Mitchell and Trevor Hamilton, skippered by Graham McDonald, defeated Nhill's Glenda Pola, Colleen Dickinson and Janette Gebert, skippered by Barry Schultz, 26-21.
